exercises.name: Flat Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Press the handles forward until your arms are fully extended. Keep your back flat against the pad and do not lock your elbows forcefully.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Press the handles upward and forward. Ensure the seat is adjusted so the handles align with your upper chest.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Press

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown

exercises.name: Single-Hand Row
exercises.instructions: Pull the D-handle back using one arm, squeezing your lat. Resist the weight pulling your torso into a twist; maintain square shoulders.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: Straddle the bar, hinge forward, and pull the handles toward your chest. Do not round your lower back; use smaller plates for better range of motion.

exercises.name: Leg Press

exercises.name: Leg Curl

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the pad backward toward your glutes. Ensure the knee pivot aligns with the machine's rotating hinge.

exercises.name: Abduction

exercises.instructions: Run in place as fast as possible. Stay on the balls of your feet and aggressively pump your arms. Keep the core tight and lean slightly forward.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Push-Ups
exercises.instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulders. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest to the floor, tucking your elbows slightly. Push back up to the starting position.

exercises.instructions: Note: This is identical to Exercise ID 73. Start in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulders. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest to the floor, tucking your elbows slightly. Push back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Ups

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width on an elevated surface. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest to the surface and press back up. Keep your core tight and do not let your hips sag.

video.title: How to Do an Incline Push-Up

exercises.name: Plank to Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Start in a forearm plank. Push up onto one hand, then the other, into a high push-up position. Lower back down to forearms one arm at a time. Keep hips level and avoid rocking side to side.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Bring hands together under your chest to form a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers. Lower your chest towards your hands. Keep your elbows tucked close to your ribs and core engaged.

video.title: How to do a Diamond Push Up

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Place hands directly under the shoulders or slightly closer. Lower your body while keeping your elbows brushing against your sides to target the triceps. Press back up powerfully.

video.title: How to Do a Close Grip Push Up

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.instructions: Lower into a squat with weight in your heels. Explode upward, jumping as high as possible. Land softly with bent knees, immediately absorbing the impact into the next squat. Keep chest up.

video.title: How To Do A Squat Jump

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting in a chair. Lower until thighs are parallel to the floor or lower. Keep your chest up, back flat, and weight in your heels.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
exercises.instructions: Stand tall, then step one foot backward and lower your hips until both knees are bent at a 90-degree angle. Keep your front knee behind your toes and your torso upright. Push off the back foot to return to standing.

video.title: How to do a Reverse Lunge

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.instructions: Step forward into a lunge, dropping the back knee toward the floor. Instead of stepping back, push through the front heel to bring the back foot forward into the next lunge. Maintain an upright torso.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Squeeze your glutes and push your hips toward the ceiling. Avoid overextending the lower back. Lower down with control.

video.title: How To Do A Glute Bridge

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.instructions: Press your back flat against a wall and slide down until your knees are at a 90-degree angle. Keep your weight through your heels, knees directly above your ankles, and core engaged. Hold the position.

video.title: How to Do a Wall Sit

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.instructions: Start in a high plank. Drive one knee toward your chest, then quickly switch legs in a running motion. Keep your hips level, core tight, and shoulders stacked directly over your wrists.

exercises.name: Skater Jumps
exercises.instructions: Push off one foot and leap laterally, landing softly on the opposite foot while sweeping the other leg behind you. Keep your back flat and use your arms for balance. Alternate sides continuously.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop into a squat, place hands on the floor, and jump feet back into a plank. Lower your chest to the deck. Press up, jump feet back to your hands, and leap vertically with full hip extension.

exercises.name: Plank Jack
exercises.instructions: Begin in a forearm or high plank position with feet together. Jump your feet wide apart, then quickly jump them back together. Keep your hips level and do not let your lower back sag.

video.title: How to Do a Plank Jack

exercises.name: Fast Feet

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with arms extended straight out to the sides. Make small, controlled circular motions. Do not shrug your shoulders. Switch directions after the specified time.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.instructions: Start on all fours. Extend your right arm forward and left leg backward simultaneously until they are parallel to the floor. Squeeze your core to avoid back arching. Return and switch sides.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.instructions: Start on all fours. Hover your knees an inch off the ground. Move forward by stepping your right hand and left foot together, then left hand and right foot. Keep hips low and back flat.

exercises.name: Side Plank Reach
exercises.instructions: Hold a side plank position. Reach your top arm toward the ceiling, then rotate your torso to thread that arm under your body. Return to the starting position. Keep hips high and shoulders stacked.

exercises.name: Hip Hinge
exercises.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain a slight bend in the knees and a neutral spine. Push your hips back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then squeeze glutes to stand tall.

exercises.instructions: Step forward into a deep lunge. Place the hand opposite your front foot on the floor. Drop your inside elbow toward your foot, then rotate that arm up toward the ceiling. Keep the back leg straight.
